propositions: Pin drift, enforcement posture, and review-phase compatibility must be surfaced in detailed CLI show, MCP ticket detail, audit output, close errors, and web ticket-review UI without modifying list output or persisted events.

DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract must be consumed consistently by all detailed renderers to display canonical related tickets, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and signed/required phases without independently recreating status strings.
When pin enforcement is disabled, observed drift must be labeled as advisory and distinguished from legacy-unpinned relationships; ordinary list output and stored ticket events remain unchanged.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity with attestation, reduced ticket state, and repo root; missing/invalid attestation or exceptions must be caught at boundary, logged, and rendered as unavailable without changing audit-trail behavior or close-gate semantics.
Output schemas must be additive and preserve rollback compatibility; affected golden tests in detailed-only paths updated while lean list assertions remain unchanged.
